metadata.title: Noir Portrait with Condensed Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white portrait featuring a subject in deep shadow with a hand to their face, paired with ultra-condensed serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a low-key, grainy black-and-white photograph of a man's face partially obscured by his hand, set against a deep black background with stark white, vertically elongated typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting defining the facial structure
Vertical tension between the elongated letterforms and the downward gaze
Heavy film grain texture unifying the image and background
Asymmetrical balance with text framing the top and right edges
coreInvariants: Monochromatic black and white color space
Heavy visible film grain or noise texture
Deep black negative space surrounding the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait centered horizontally but weighted toward the bottom, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated bridge of the nose and the hand resting against the cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the highlighted facial features, and follows the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive deep black space at the top and left, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Stark white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays within the film grain
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between large condensed serif and small spaced-out sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Vertical text orientation for secondary information

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main title
Lowercase styling for the main title
avoid: Horizontal orientation for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed serif profile with high contrast.
Appropriate for the clean, spaced-out secondary vertical text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait of a man looking down with his hand against his face, surrounded by deep black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, ultra-condensed serif font at the top. Add secondary text vertically on the right side in a small, spaced-out white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the main title font ultra-condensed and serif?
Is there a heavy film grain texture across the entire composition?
Is the secondary text oriented vertically?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical elongation in typography
Placement of the subject within the frame
postGenerationChecks: Ensure grain does not obscure the letterforms
Verify the vertical stacking of the right-side text
Confirm the mood is somber and noir-inspired
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + ultra-condensed serif + heavy film grain = Noir Editorial Aesthetic
